1. (Currently Amended) A segment for a robotic arm comprising:a shaft having a first end and a second end, wherein the first end and the second end have different dimensions and wherein the second end is positioned transverse to an axis of the shaft;
a first joint housing having a first recess and a second recess;
a second joint housing having a first cavity and a second cavity,
whereby the first recess is engageable with the first cavity to form a first socket, and the second recess is engageable with the second cavity to form a second socket; and
the first socket is engageable with the first end of the shaft to facilitate movement alongina longitudinal rollaxis, and the second socket is engageable with the second end of the shaft to facilitate movement along a lateral pitch axis.
2. (Original) The segment of claim 1, wherein the first joint housing is dimensionally similar to the second joint housing.
3. (Original) The segment of claim 1, wherein the first recess is dimensionally similar to the first cavity and the second recess is dimensionally similar to the second cavity.
4. (Original) The segment of claim 1, wherein the shaft comprises a first shaft portion in connection with a second shaft portion.
5. (Original) The segment of claim 1, further comprising a first actuator for rotating the shaft along a longitudinal axis and a second actuator for rotating the shaft along a lateral axis.
6. (Original) The segment of claim 5, wherein the first joint housing further comprises a third recess and a fourth recess, and wherein the second joint housing further comprises a third cavity and a fourth cavity, whereby the third recess and third cavity are engageable to house the first actuator, and whereby the fourth recess and fourth cavity are engageable to house the second actuator.
7. (Original) The segment of claim 1, further comprising an end effector in connection with the shaft.
8. (Currently Amended) The segment of claim -75,further comprising a third actuator in connection with the end effector.
9. (Original) The segment of claim 5, wherein the first end of the shaft comprises an indentation for receiving the first actuator.
10. (Currently Amended) A robotic arm comprising at least one segment, each segment further comprising:a shaft having a first end and a second end wherein the first end comprises a sphere and the second end comprises a cylinder offset in orientation from an axis of a length of the shaft;
a first joint housing having a first recess and a second recess;
a second joint housing having a first cavity and a second cavity,
whereby the first recess is engageable with the first cavity to form a first socket and the second recess is engageable with the second cavity to form a second socket; and
the first socket is engageable with the first end of the shaft to facilitate movement along in a longitudinal rollaxis, and the second socket is engageable with the second end of the shaft to facilitate movement along a lateral pitch axis.
11. (Original) The robotic arm of claim 10, wherein the number of segments is two.
12. (Original) The robotic arm of claim 10, wherein the number of segments is three.
13. (Original) The robotic arm of claim 10, wherein the number of segments is at least four.
